title: LibScript T5 Shared Workload, Resource & Tenant Definitions
description: Shared T5 resource, port, secret, artifact, and tenant-binding definitions referenced across libscript.schema.json, payload.schema.json, and ml-workload.schema.json.

computeResources.description: Compute, memory, GPU, and Cloud TPU resource request specification

gpu_count.description: Number of discrete GPUs requested per replica

tpu_accelerator_type.description: Cloud TPU accelerator SKU (e.g., v4-8, v5litepod-8, v6e-8)

tpu_slice_count.description: Number of coordinated TPU slices for gang-scheduled jobs

servicePort.description: Declared network listener port for a workload or stack service

name.description: Logical port name (e.g., http, grpc, metrics)

port.description: Listening TCP or UDP port number
